Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned Government Advocate for the State of U.P. and
perused the record.
The instant application has been preferred for the following main relief:-
"Wherefore, it is most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may kindly be
pleased to direct the Learned trial court i.e. Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate
Court No. 20, Sultanpur to expedite and conclude the trial of criminal Case No. 9137
